explanation: Thumbs-up is one of the safest, most widely used positive gestures in Brazil, signaling approval or that everything is fine, in both casual and business settings. It has also become the preferred way to say 'okay' precisely because the circular OK hand sign is considered vulgar in Brazil.
local_tip: Use a thumbs-up freely to show approval or agreement — it is understood and welcomed in almost any context, from traffic to business meetings.

also_check.note: The thumbs-up can be read as an insult comparable to the middle finger.
The gesture is widely seen as obscene, roughly equivalent to 'up yours'.
The gesture can be seen as rude or offensive by some, particularly older generations, so a nod or verbal thanks is safer.
